reports.text: [Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/11/they-re-bringing-something-kushner-and-witkoff-to-meet-putin-in-moscow-day-after-abu-dhabi-peace-talks) reported that U.S. presidential special envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff will meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow following the Abu Dhabi peace talks.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2026/11/11/russia-ukraine-peace-talks-conclude-in-abu-dhabi-with-prisoner-exchange-agreement-but-no-breakthrough-on-territory) reported that the trilateral talks between Russia, Ukraine, and the United States in Abu Dhabi ended with a prisoner exchange agreement but no breakthrough on territory.

[Military.com](https://www.military.com/russia-and-ukraine-agree-to-a-large-prisoner-exchange-as-talks-conclude-with-no-major-breakthrough) reported that Russia and Ukraine agreed to a large prisoner exchange as talks concluded with no major breakthrough.

[NPR World](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/11/g-s1-152954/russia-ukraine-war-talks) reported that Russia and Ukraine agreed to a large exchange of prisoners of war following U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi.

[CBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxNYTROYzl6bktWaUk4MEdWZXVKN2RYeFR2c0YzMlRtT1VUVW9JZ0hlMklxd0NDYVNtRkdRVTEtV2hZU0pMNlFlNDdESURHcTNMakFYSnlnNEwxbGE3bHVCS2d1dVRuOWhBUmNfYUhXNzE3bVc0VTF2MjluSzhzSThIeWtLSTlEQQ?oc=5) reported that U.S.-mediated Russia-Ukraine talks ended with news of good momentum and a large-scale prisoner swap.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxQV2RpSFF1Ym9mZkNRLTAyOFVnRk5JbzJmMmEydmFjMl9TS0lBdER0LVNieEZiSWlveXBwdjZtRkZuVWlWalBpdnNlZnZ6RmEtX3A2S0trZFF6OElSa0UyM1IxY1hUd1dnXzZzb2NZRVRkNUxJQmcycHhLN3JhRGo4RUo2N241cHpVeHMxWFlVeENaTFVtYk5GUUR6R3NYX2RxdmthQ0dKNlhKUkprN2tpNDVtVFhfWGVxUHlVbnN0bjRrUDA?oc=5) reported that a Russian negotiator noted some progress after Ukraine talks and stated there is no EU role in the process for now.

[HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/us-brokered-russia-ukraine-talks-abu-dhabi_n_6af43d31e4b09e0b5c534308) reported that envoys from Russia and Ukraine met for four hours in Abu Dhabi for the second day of US-brokered talks.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/russia-ukraine-agree-to-prisoner-swap-at-us-brokered-talks/article71689267.ece) reported that Russia and Ukraine agreed to a major prisoner swap following US-brokered talks in Abu Dhabi.

[Daily Times (Pakistan)](https://dailytimes.com.pk/1579894/russia-ukraine-and-us-resume-abu-dhabi-peace-talks/) reported that Russian, Ukrainian, and US officials started the second day of peace talks in Abu Dhabi to explore ways to end the ongoing war.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russian-attacks-kill-9-injure-39-across-ukraine-over-past-day-as-2-russian-cruise-missiles-violate-moldovan-airspace/) reported that Russian forces launched a Kh-59/69 guided missile from the Black Sea and 163 long-range attack drones over the past day, while Moldovan airspace was violated by cruise missiles.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/11/ukrainian-negotiator-says-peace-talks-with-russia-could-produce-a-deal-before-the-new-year) reported that Davyd Arakhamia stated that participants in the peace talks between Russia and Ukraine could reach a resolution before the end of the year.

[El País](https://elpais.com/internacional/2026-11-11/las-negociaciones-de-abu-dabi-sobre-ucrania-concluyen-con-un-canje-de-prisioneros-y-sin-progresos-para-la-paz.html) reported that negotiations in Abu Dhabi concluded with a prisoner exchange and without progress toward peace, as the Kremlin pushes to link the invasion with European security reviews.

[Le Monde](https://www.lemonde.fr/international/live/2026/11/11/en-direct-guerre-en-ukraine-accord-de-principe-avec-la-russie-pour-un-nouvel-echange-de-prisonniers-de-guerre-a-grande-echelle_6808609_3210.html) reported that Vladimir Medinsky announced an agreement in principle with Russia for a large-scale prisoner exchange following the Abu Dhabi talks.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/russia-ukraine-start-second-day-of-us-led-talks-kyiv-lead-negotiator) reported that Russia and Ukraine resumed US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi for a second day, according to Kyiv's chief negotiator Rustem Umerov.

[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxPOTZBa1dKdjVHLWFUdklVcGRSZWMzbUVwVlVPYjVZNUpjbDU0NjBESjhwNEZMUjRtbm9hWGhfRzFZVEFDN0NjU2dKdE5hZmRwajhnWGJUQWdHbkNTOHZkWTM1anlBRFlUU3dXcXlGaXZxcnNuc2NVMHZOUzZBVGVIZGFWaTBWR1VLZmtkb2o1Y1F2dHA3TVhMRlF1OTE?oc=5) reported that Russia pounded Ukraine's power grid as talks opened in Abu Dhabi.

[DW](https://www.dw.com/en/us-russia-and-ukraine-wrap-up-abu-dhabi-talks/live-79906232?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf) reported that peace talks between Russia, Ukraine, and the US concluded in the United Arab Emirates after two days.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/202667/%D9%85%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%AB%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A3%D9%88%D9%83%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A3%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%B8%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D9%83%D9%88%D8%B4%D9%86%D8%B1-%D9%88%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%AA%D9%83%D9%88%D9%81-%D8%A5%D9%84%D9%89-%D9%85%D9%88%D8%B3%D9%83%D9%88/) reported that U.S. envoy Jared Kushner stated on Wednesday that he will travel to Moscow on Thursday with U.S. envoy Steve Witkoff.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/abu-dhabi-trilateral-talks-to-end-russia-ukraine-war-enter-2nd-day) reported that Russian, Ukrainian, and U.S. officials held a second day of peace talks in Abu Dhabi on Wednesday following constructive meetings.

[Asharq News](https://asharq.com/politics/202543/%D9%84%D9%84%D9%8A%D9%88%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AB%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%A6%D9%86%D8%A7%D9%81-%D9%85%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%AB%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A3%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%B8%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AB%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AB%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D8%B4%D8%A3%D9%86-%D8%A3%D9%88%D9%83%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A7/) reported that Russia, Ukraine, and the United States resumed their trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi for the second consecutive day to discuss ways to end the war.

[BILD](https://www.bild.de/politik/ausland-und-internationales/putins-verlogene-verhandlungen-in-abu-dhabi-reden-sie-in-der-ukraine-bomben-sie-6af428fde22aeb948141f6fd) reported that Moscow attacked Ukraine while peace talks were taking place in Abu Dhabi.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/11/ukraine-rejects-u-s-proposal-to-redraw-donetsk-and-luhansk-borders-the-telegraph-reports) reported that Ukraine rejected a U.S. proposal to redraw the borders of the Donetsk and Luhansk regions.

[O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/mundo/noticia/2026/11/11/ucrania-e-russia-encerram-segundo-dia-de-negociacao-em-abu-dhabi-sem-anuncios-mas-com-promessa-de-novos-dialogos.ghtml) reported that representatives of the US, Russia, and Ukraine concluded a second day of negotiations in Abu Dhabi without announcements but with a promise of further dialogues.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/nov/11/europe-ukraine-russia-us-talks-abu-dhabi-zelenskyy-latest-news-updates) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is happy with the approach of US envoys as trilateral talks between Ukraine, Russia, and the US enter their second day in Abu Dhabi.

Novaya Gazeta Europe reported that the second day of negotiations between Russia, Ukraine, and the United States began in Abu Dhabi behind closed doors ([Novaya Gazeta Europe](https://novayagazeta.eu/articles/2026/11/11/v-abu-dabi-nachalsia-vtoroi-den-peregovorov-rossii-ukrainy-i-ssha-news)).

Ukrinform reported that the second day of trilateral talks between Ukraine, the United States, and Russia on ending the war started in Abu Dhabi on Wednesday ([Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4183675-second-day-of-trilateral-talks-begins-in-abu-dhabi.html)).

Ukrinform reported that Russian forces attacked energy infrastructure in the southern part of the Odesa region overnight, resulting in the death of a woman ([Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4183660-russian-strikes-hit-energy-infrastructure-in-southern-odesa-region.html)).

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20261111-live-ukraine-russia-hold-second-day-of-us-mediated-talks-in-abu-dhabi) reported that Ukraine and Russia held a second day of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi as Washington called for a new security framework.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2043580/us-calls-for-new-europe-security-framework-as-russia-ukraine-hold-first-peace-talks-in-9-months) reported that a first day of US-led talks between Ukraine and Russia in Abu Dhabi ended, with Washington calling for a new security framework.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-10/news-1RXskAxlM1q/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that a new round of trilateral talks involving Russia, the United States and Ukraine began in Abu Dhabi.

[CGTN](https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-11-10/news-1RXpE3onnfq/p.html?UTM_Source=cgtn&UTM_Medium=rss&UTM_Campaign=World) reported that the Ukrainian delegation met U.S. envoys ahead of the Russia talks.

[RT](https://rt-english.com/news/648693-russia-ukraine-us-talks-second-day/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=RSS) reported that the second day of Russia-Ukraine-US talks has kicked off in Abu Dhabi.

[Meduza](https://meduza.io/en/news/2026/11/11/zelensky-says-russian-delegation-claimed-to-control-parts-of-donbas-still-held-by-ukraine-at-abu-dhabi-talks) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that Russia's delegation at the talks in Abu Dhabi overstated the size of the territory it occupies in Donbas.

[Rzeczpospolita](https://www.rp.pl/konflikty-zbrojne/art45474291-ukrainskie-drony-zaatakowaly-rosyjski-port-nad-baltykiem-sa-poszkodowani) reported that Ukrainian drones attacked the port of Ust-Luga in the Leningrad region, causing a fire.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/ukraine/2026/1111/1598783-ukraine-russia/) reported that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said he was happy with US mediators' change in approach during the talks in Abu Dhabi.

[United Daily News (Taiwan)](https://udn.com/news/story/6809/9870550) reported that Russian and Ukrainian officials held talks in Abu Dhabi mediated by the US, focusing on security guarantees while territorial issues remain a core dispute.

[Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/ukrainian-strikes-cut-russias-oil-refining-capacity-by-30-reuters-reports/) reported that Ukrainian strikes cut Russia's oil refining capacity by 30% according to Reuters.
[RIA Novosti](https://ria.ru/20261110/zelenskij-2130732043.html) (state-media) reported that President Zelensky called the first day of negotiations in Abu Dhabi constructive.

[Ukrainska Pravda](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/11/10/8062179/) reported that US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the trilateral negotiations in the UAE were productive and that a significant amount of work remains.

[RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-ukraine-abu-dhabi-war-peace-talks/33894644.html) reported that Ukrainian and Russian negotiators wrapped up the first of two days of US-brokered talks aimed at ending the war.

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-11/ukraine-russia-talks-abu-dhabi/107371042) reported that envoys from Kyiv, Moscow, and Washington D.C. discussed security guarantees, territorial concessions, and a Europe-wide security framework at their first meeting.

stories.title: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth Impeachment Effort

reports.text: [The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/pete-hegseth-impeachment-vote-democrats-b3083064.html) reported that California Representative Sydney Kamlager-Dove criticized colleagues after a resolution against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth failed.

[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/11/first-thing-pete-hegseth-survives-effort-to-impeach-him) reported that House Republicans blocked an impeachment resolution that cited US military actions in Iran, Yemen, and Venezuela.

[Yeni Şafak (English)](http://en.yenisafak.com/world/vance-defends-hegseth-labels-impeachment-push-ridiculous-show-3725437) reported that US Vice President JD Vance defended Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and dismissed an impeachment resolution as a ridiculous show.

[The New Arab](https://www.newarab.com/news/us-house-votes-derail-impeachment-hegseth) reported that Republicans in the US House of Representatives banded together to derail an effort to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.
[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cxly4y5jzl0qo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that the US House blocked a bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth for now.

[The Independent World](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/hegseth-impeachment-vote-news-house-b3082802.html) reported that Donald Trump took a victory lap after the House GOP shelved the Pete Hegseth impeachment articles.

[The Hindu (World)](https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/us-republicans-derail-bid-to-impeach-hegseth/article71687959.ece) reported that the U.S. House voted 211 to 204 to send the impeachment resolution to the Judiciary Committee.

[NZ Herald](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/embattled-pentagon-chief-slams-impeachment-farce/W7JRTBI6NZAKZNPDSPUIEQWPFI/) reported that the articles accused Pete Hegseth of misconduct over Iran, Yemen and boat strikes.
[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/svet/hegset-preziveo-pokusaj-opoziva/lgp5w4q) reported that Republicans in the US House of Representatives blocked an initiative to impeach Pete Hegseth.

[La Razón](https://www.larazon.es/internacional/congresistas-republicanos-bloquean-juicio-politico-hegseth_202611116af42580ea8d89799781613d.html) reported that the impeachment was pushed by Representative Thomas Massie.

[Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/11/us-republicans-block-efforts-to-impeach-us-defence-secretary-pete-hegseth-over-iran-war) reported that Hegseth defended operations he led in Yemen, Iran, and against alleged drug smugglers.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/us/politics/house-hegseth-impeachment-vote.html) reported that Republicans turned back an effort to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, sparing him from potential ouster.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/us/politics/hegseth-speech-impeachment-takeaways.html) reported that Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth defended his record in office during a news briefing.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261110-it-s-a-farce-hegseth-slams-impeachment-effort) reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth dismissed a move to impeach him by a Republican lawmaker as a farce and a political stunt.

[United Daily News (Taiwan)](https://udn.com/news/story/6809/9870543) reported that US Defense Minister Pete Hegseth called the impeachment initiative a farce and stated that attacking Iran was the right decision after Kentucky Republican Representative Thomas Massie introduced an impeachment motion.

[Blic](https://www.blic.rs/vesti/svet/hegsetu-preti-opoziv-evo-sta-mu-se-stavlja-na-teret-prvo-obracanje-ministra-odbrane/jkwd2m4) reported that US Defense Minister Pete Hegseth said at a press conference in the Pentagon that the impeachment initiative is based on political disagreements.

[El País](https://english.elpais.com/usa/2026-11-10/pete-hegseth-on-impeachment-effort-it-is-a-farce-and-its-a-stunt-and-everybody-knows-it.html) reported that Pete Hegseth held his first press conference in six months after Republican Congressman Thomas Massie launched proceedings to remove him from office.

[RTÉ](https://www.rte.ie/news/2026/1110/1598704-pete-hegseth-dismisses-impeachment-effort/) reported that US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth called an effort to impeach him over abuse of power in the Iran war a farce and sabotage.

[New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/us/politics/nancy-lacore-hegseth-impeachment.html) reported that Nancy Lacore, who was chief of the Navy reserve until last year and will represent a House district starting in January, was fired by Hegseth and supports his ouster.

[South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/us/politics/article/3373990/hegseth-calls-impeachment-bid-farce-he-defends-iran-war) reported that US Secretary of Defence Pete Hegseth called an impeachment bill against him a farce while defending the ongoing war in Iran and air strikes.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/house-set-to-vote-on-pete-hegseth-impeachment-resolution-today-says-thomas-massie-101794322788233.html) reported that Congressman Thomas Massie stated the House will first consider a motion to stop the impeachment resolution against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/pete-hegseth-pentagon-briefing-us-defense-chief-dismisses-impeachment-move-as-political-spectacle-101794316626350.html) reported that US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth dismissed the impeachment move as a political spectacle and stated he stands beside every operation in the Iran war.

reports.text: [Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/190016/%D8%B4%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D9%8A%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%AA%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%B9-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B6%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B6%D9%81%D8%A9) reported that Hamas leader Abdul Rahman Shadid warned against the acceleration of land expropriation and settlement expansion in the West Bank.

[Associated Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxOR2xtdC1iNFRNSEZwNjVlM1hTeFVjREM0MlU4ZFlaWkVBYnQyNmxEdnZKeXRLQXBmbVVOeHI1U1l0TFN2cG1tQS02TFV0OElNUzhqZ1dRbUVfS3BtTVphOVFud1R6N1hZdGlpVl9GVE45dk93akNtcGRhUFB6cmpOd0FZbC1GOXBFendqUmtmalYwcUJybFo2WWRtOA?oc=5) reported that Israel's president gave Eisenkot the first chance to form the next government.

[Africanews](http://www.africanews.com/2026/11/11/israel-swears-in-new-parliament-as-netanyahu-remains-caretaker-pm/) reported that Gadi Eisenkot, tasked with forming a new Israeli government, pledged to reverse many of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's policies.

[The Jerusalem Post](https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/crime-in-israel/article-914571) reported that Amit Hadad, Netanyahu’s lawyer, stated that the judges could summon Baharav-Miara regardless of her position and that the door remains open to talks.

[Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261111-netanyahu-rejects-palestinian-state-warns-of-iran-threat-and-calls-for-unity-government/) reported that outgoing Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu warned of potential international pressure on Israel to withdraw from territories it controls in Gaza.

[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/11/11/netanyahu-heckled-by-bennett-at-knesset-opening-session?traffic_source=rss) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu was heckled by Naftali Bennett at the Knesset opening session.

[France 24](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261110-eisenkot-pushes-october-7-inquiry-as-netanyahu-targets-arab-parties-in-tense-new-parliament) reported that Gadi Eisenkot pledged to launch an official inquiry into Hamas's October 7, 2023 attack.

[Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/israel-politics-sara-netanyahu-heated-shouting-match-with-naftali-bennett-during-benjamin-netanyahus-knesset-address-101794372417173.html) reported that Naftali Bennett and Sara Netanyahu got into a heated exchange after the former questioned caretaker PM Benjamin Netanyahu about his Qatari advisers.

[Daily Sabah](https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/eisenkot-vows-to-undo-netanyahu-policies-as-israeli-parliament-opens) reported that Israeli Prime Minister-designate Gadi Eisenkot pledged to dismantle key policies of outgoing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as the newly opened parliament began.

[HuffPost World](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/israel-election-eisenkot-netanyahu_n_6aeff8afe4b0d2d11fa40151) reported that Israeli President Isaac Herzog tapped opposition candidate Gadi Eisenkot to form a governing coalition in a setback for Netanyahu.

[Felesteen](https://felesteen.news/post/189964/%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%B3%D9%83%D8%B1-%D8%A2%D9%8A%D8%B2%D9%86%D9%83%D9%88%D8%AA-%D9%8A%D8%B7%D8%B1%D8%AD-%D9%82%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%AD%D9%82%D9%8A%D9%82-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A5%D8%AE%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%AA-7-%D8%A3%D9%83%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%A8%D8%B1) reported that Gadi Eisenkot's 'Yashar' party submitted bills to the Knesset, led by establishing an official commission of inquiry into October 7 failures.

[Haaretz](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-politics/2026-11-10/ty-article/.premium/arab-party-to-back-eisenkot-blocs-bid-to-replace-knesset-speaker/000001a1-c553-dba2-a9f9-d57fa5ce0000) reported that Arab-led Joint List lawmaker Ahmad Tibi said his party would back the Eisenkot bloc's Knesset speaker nominee.

[New York Times World](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/world/middleeast/israel-parliament-eisenkot.html) reported that dozens of first-time lawmakers headed to the Knesset, where the opposition led by Gadi Eisenkot has a majority.

[BBC World](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/crd939lpzjp9o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) reported that Benjamin Netanyahu's main political rival, Gadi Eisenkot, had the first chance to build a new government and oust the prime minister.

[The Guardian World](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/08/gadi-eisenkot-netanyahu-allies-form-israel-government) reported that former military chief Gadi Eisenkot reached out to Netanyahu allies as he strived to form a government.

[The Guardian World](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/07/israel-president-gadi-eisenkot-form-government) reported that Israel's president chose Yashar leader Gadi Eisenkot to form a government after the Knesset had been deadlocked.

[Dawn (Pakistan)](https://www.dawn.com/news/2043517/new-israel-parliament-to-be-sworn-in-as-gadi-eisenkot-seeks-government) reported that Israel's new parliament was sworn in as Gadi Eisenkot works to form a government while Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu loses his majority.

According to [Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261109-former-israeli-prime-minister-barak-urges-eisenkot-to-accelerate-government-formation/), former Israeli Prime Minister Ehud Barak urged Gadi Eisenkot to accelerate efforts to form a new government.

The Jerusalem Post reported that Israeli President Isaac Herzog warned against the continuation of certain policies during a ceremony to officially task Gadi Eisenkot with forming a new government ([Naharnet](https://www.naharnet.com/stories/en/323654-herzog-tells-eisenkot-to-continue-negotiations-with-lebanon)).

Middle East Monitor reported that members of Israel's Shas party are considering supporting an Eisenkot-led government if United Torah Judaism joins ([Middle East Monitor](https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20261109-shas-reportedly-open-to-supporting-eizenkot-led-government-if-united-torah-judaism-joins/)).

[ABC Australia](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-10/who-is-jensen-huang-and-why-is-nvidia-ceo-scandal-important/107368698) reported that Nvidia's value plummeted after news broke of CEO Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese intelligence asset.

[Sky News World](https://news.sky.com/story/fbi-to-investigate-nvidia-ceo-over-affair-with-alleged-chinese-spy-trump-says-13610382) reported that Donald Trump stated the FBI is looking into Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy while describing him as a very honorable man.

[Antara](https://en.antaranews.com/news/441795/all-house-factions-submit-proposal-to-impeach-vp-gibran) reported that all political party factions in Indonesia's House of Representatives submitted a formal Right to Express proposal to impeach Vice President Gibran.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-vice-president-gibran-rakabuming-raka-intention-step-down-6538841) reported that Indonesian VP Gibran expressed intent to step down, while a presidential spokesperson denied reports that President Prabowo Subianto rejected the request.

[CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-politicians-psi-ministers-joko-widodo-son-6538586) reported that three politicians in Prabowo's Cabinet resigned from the party led by Jokowi's son.
